source_authority: SEBI / AMFI Category Classification Standard & NSE Benchmark TRI

Healthcare.source_citation: NSE Indices Limited Factsheet (NIFTY PHARMA TRI) & AMFI Sector/Thematic Direct Category Statistics
Healthcare.calculation_methodology: 3-year daily rolling returns, standard deviation, and Jensen's alpha against NIFTY PHARMA TRI; TER bounds from monthly AMFI portfolio disclosures.

Flexi Cap.source_citation: NSE Indices Limited Factsheet (NIFTY 500 TRI) & AMFI Flexi Cap Direct Peer Distribution
Flexi Cap.calculation_methodology: 3-year daily rolling returns and multi-cap alpha relative to NIFTY 500 TRI; 5th-95th percentile winsorization across Direct Growth universe.

Mid Cap.source_citation: NSE Indices Limited Factsheet (NIFTY MIDCAP 150 TRI) & AMFI Mid Cap Category Averages
Mid Cap.calculation_methodology: 3-year rolling alpha, Sharpe, and downside buffer relative to NIFTY MIDCAP 150 TRI.

Large Cap.source_citation: NSE Indices Limited Factsheet (NIFTY 100 TRI) & AMFI Large Cap Direct Peer Distribution
Large Cap.calculation_methodology: 3-year rolling alpha and Sharpe ratio against NIFTY 100 TRI; TER bounds reflecting SEBI slab limits for large cap funds.

Small Cap.source_citation: NSE Indices Limited Factsheet (NIFTY SMALLCAP 250 TRI) & AMFI Small Cap Category Statistics
Small Cap.calculation_methodology: 3-year rolling alpha, volatility-adjusted Sharpe, and downside buffer against NIFTY SMALLCAP 250 TRI.

Multi Cap.source_citation: NSE Indices Limited Factsheet (NIFTY 500 MULTICAP 50:25:25 TRI) & AMFI Multi Cap Direct Statistics
Multi Cap.calculation_methodology: 3-year rolling alpha and Sharpe ratio against mandated 50:25:25 multi-cap benchmark TRI.

Large & Mid Cap.source_citation: NSE Indices Limited Factsheet (NIFTY LARGEMIDCAP 250 TRI) & AMFI Large & Mid Cap Direct Distribution
Large & Mid Cap.calculation_methodology: 3-year rolling alpha, Sharpe, and downside buffer against NIFTY LARGEMIDCAP 250 TRI.
